ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 12:1 low-intensity (black) pixels to high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation across 90% of the fluke. Distinct high-contrast white circular ring motifs (3-15 pixels in diameter) are scattered as isolated blobs, with higher spatial density in the lower-medial quadrant of the right lobe and central region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 72 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serration frequency. The continuous boundary exhibits multiple peaks and valleys with 10-20 pixel amplitudes. A significant 45-pixel depth rectangular negative-space anomaly is located on the right lobe's distal trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curve from median notch to distal tips, heavily segmented and disrupted by deep trailing edge serrations and missing tissue segments.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of white circular pixel rings (rosettes) corresponding to barnacle attachment points; approximately 12 distinct clusters on the right lobe and 10 on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major acquired tissue loss on the right lobe trailing edge forming a step-like rectangular profile; extensive white rosette scarring across the dark ventral field.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely tattered and eroded trailing edge morphology with multiple high-amplitude jagged indentations.
